name: Palworld
short: Gifts press Palworld's own keys: jump, roll, throw a Pal Sphere, swap Pals
description: Gifts press Palworld's keys while you play: jump, roll, crouch, run forward, throw a Pal Sphere, call out or recall your Pal, use its partner skill, reload or swap to another Pal. Works in single player, co-op and on servers, because nothing is installed and nothing talks to a server.
warning: Key presses only. Palworld's server console (RCON, and its newer REST API) can only broadcast messages, save, list, kick and ban players, and shut down. It can't spawn Pals or items or change the weather, so there's no console to connect here. Key presses go to whichever window is in front.

requirements.detail: The ideas below use Palworld's default keyboard layout. If you changed a key in Palworld's options, change it in the GiftDeck event too.

keys.name: Roll
keys.idea: A small gift makes you dodge-roll

keys.name: Run forward
keys.idea: Hold W for 2 seconds: a gift sends you running ahead

keys.name: Run backwards
keys.idea: Hold S: a viewer drags you back

keys.name: Throw a Pal Sphere
keys.idea: A viewer throws a Pal Sphere wherever you're looking

keys.name: Call out or recall your Pal
keys.idea: A gift sends your Pal out, or back into its sphere

keys.name: Partner skill
keys.idea: A big gift fires your Pal's partner skill

keys.name: Swap Pal (left)
keys.idea: Switch the Pal you have selected

keys.name: Swap Pal (right)
keys.idea: Switch the Pal you have selected the other way

keys.name: Change sphere
keys.idea: Switch which Pal Sphere you throw

guide.title: Start Palworld
guide.text: Play in single player, co-op or on a server: key presses work everywhere, because GiftDeck only presses keys on this PC. Windowed or borderless is easiest while streaming.

guide.title: Let GiftDeck bring the game to the front
guide.text: Key presses go to the window that's in front. Press "Use this game's window for key presses" on this page: GiftDeck then brings the window with Pal in its title to the front before pressing keys. If a key press lands somewhere else, check the exact title of Palworld's window (hover over it in the taskbar) and put that in GiftDeck's settings instead.

guide.title: Add gift events
guide.text: In an event, add the action "Press keys" and type a key from the ideas on this page, for example Space for a Rose (jump) or Q for a bigger gift (throw a Pal Sphere). For "run forward", set how long to hold W. Pair key presses with GiftDeck's own sound, alert or text to speech so viewers see who did it.

guide.title: Why there's no console for Palworld
guide.text: Palworld's dedicated server has RCON and a REST API, but they only broadcast messages, save the world, list, kick, ban and unban players, and shut the server down. Nothing spawns Pals, gives items or changes the world. Pocketpair also says RCON is deprecated and will stop working in a future update, and RCON's Broadcast cuts messages at the first space. For on-screen messages, GiftDeck's alerts and text to speech do a better job.
